lastCompletedStory.title: cam config merge_mode change + branch-protection setup

nextStoryContext: US-004 adds a merge-mode WizardStep to ConfigScreen (after the backend step) and extends mergeConfigChoices() to write [ship] merge_mode to project.toml and call applyMergeMode() when ci-gated. MergeModeOpts (exported from config.ts) has spawnFn/emitHint/emitWarning/emitResult/ownerRepo for test injection. ConfigChoices now has an optional mergeMode?: MergeMode field (optional preserves backward compat with existing config-persist tests). The ConfigScreen allSteps array is [...PHASE_STEPS, 'backend', 'merge-mode', 'done']. collectViaInk passes production emitters (printHint, printWarning, process.stdout.write) via mergeModeOpts. US-003 helper applyMergeMode() is reused directly.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed 4 required fields: required_status_checks, enforce_admins, required_pull_request_reviews, restrictions. Implementation in configureBranchProtection (US-002) matches. US-004 reuses applyMergeMode unchanged.
